cases.title: CASE 001 — THE VANISHING FILE
cases.tagline: A confidential CRISPR-AI research file has vanished from the University Bio-Informatics Vault.
cases.location: Apex Bio-Informatics Lab, University Central Research Facility

victim.name: Dr. Maya Rao
victim.statement: I stepped out of the lab at 19:30 to grab coffee in the cafeteria. When I returned at 20:45, my workstation was unlocked, and 'PROJECT_CHIMERA_GENOME.enc' was completely purged from the local encrypted drive.

cases.motive: Financial payoff and corporate espionage. Ryan was promised $150,000 in cryptocurrency by rival biotech firm NexaGen to deliver the Chimera sequencing algorithm.
cases.method: Ryan obtained Maya's physical keycard when she briefly left her desk at 19:30. Using lab terminal #04 at 19:42, he executed a custom data exfiltration script onto an encrypted USB drive, aided by an SSH jump-box configured by Sam Verma.
cases.opportunity: Ryan claimed to be studying at Central Library between 19:10 and 20:30. However, CCTV Camera 04 recorded a hooded figure matching his jacket exiting the rear lab fire stairs at 19:47, and network router logs show the SSH connection routed from the library terminal directly to the lab subnet.

solution_summary.smoking_gun: CCTV Footage #1047 (matching Ryan's navy jacket at fire escape at 19:47) combined with Terminal Log #1061 (exfiltration at 19:42) and Encrypted Chat #1120 between Ryan and Sam discussing the payload payout.
solution_summary.accomplice_link: Sam Verma provided the SSH bypass script in exchange for 20% of the crypto bounty.

red_herrings.reason: Arjun had a heated argument with Dr. Maya regarding authorship earlier, but was having coffee with Nisha Kapoor at Costa Cafe from 19:15 to 20:30 (verified by Cafe CCTV #1035 and receipts).
Aisha holds root administrative keys and accessed the project directory the day before, but cryptographic server logs show no modifications during the 19:00-21:00 window.
Dev triggered a security alert at Server Room B at 20:10, but logs prove he was investigating an unannounced network power surge caused by Sam's proxy router.
